description: This C# source file defines an internal class 'StreamConsumerGrainContextAction' that implements 'IConfigureGrainContext'. The class installs a stream consumer extension on a grain context if the grain implements 'IStreamSubscriptionObserver'. It manages the binding of 'StreamConsumerExtension' to 'IStreamConsumerExtension' using an 'IStreamProviderRuntime'.

classes.name: StreamConsumerGrainContextAction
classes.description: Internal class that configures grain contexts to include stream consumer extension for grains implementing 'IStreamSubscriptionObserver'.

methods.name: StreamConsumerGrainContextAction
methods.description: Constructor initializing the class with an 'IStreamProviderRuntime' instance.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures a grain context by installing a stream consumer extension if the grain implements 'IStreamSubscriptionObserver'.

methods.name: InstallStreamConsumerExtension
methods.description: Installs a 'StreamConsumerExtension' as an 'IStreamConsumerExtension' on the grain context.
